purpose: Measure a conservative CPU process-per-state baseline for the same nstates used by the GPU scaling gate.
preconditions: tlul_slice_host_probe is built from the README flow
reports/tlul_fifo_sync_scaling_validation.json exists when CPU/GPU comparison fields are requested

allowed_claims: CPU process-per-state wall time for the same nstates as the GPU scaling gate
GPU batched throughput from the existing scaling report
conservative CPU/GPU throughput ratio for this seed and gate shape
non_claims: not an exact single-process CPU loop speedup because each CPU state invokes the host probe process
not a full RTL application throughput claim
no target-breadth claim because only tlul_fifo_sync is exercised
comparison_policy.next_precision_step: replace process-per-state CPU timing with a single-process host loop if the conservative ratio is promising
